candidates.change_summary: Return the ERC1967 admin slot instead of the implementation slot.
Return the ERC1967 beacon slot instead of the implementation slot.
Return a zero bytes32 value instead of the implementation slot.
Remove the __Access_init(_accessControl) call so the accessControl address is never stored, making subsequent access-checked calls revert with AccessDenied (checking against address(0)).
Remove `$._initialized = 1;` so the initialized version never advances past 0, allowing initialize(...) to be called repeatedly instead of reverting with InvalidInitialization on the second call.
Remove `$._initializing = true;` so the initializing flag is never set, causing onlyInitializing guards in __Access_init to revert with NotInitializing and making initialize(...) always revert.
Change `$._initialized = 1;` to `$._initialized = 2;` so the recorded initialization version is 2 instead of 1, observable via _getInitializedVersion-dependent guards and reinitializer behavior.
